name: auto-route-for-codex
description: Capability-gated model routing and safe task continuation for Codex Desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Route models and continue tasks safely
interface.longDescription: Runs only when explicitly invoked. Recommends a sufficient Codex setting and, when live Codex Desktop capabilities and evidence pass every gate, continues through a verified fork before archiving the source task.
defaultPrompt: $auto-route-for-codex Route this task only when the verified benefit exceeds transfer cost.
